    About Us

    Tablea To-Go is a proposed food and beverage business in Cebu City, Philippines, offering tablea cacao tablets, ready-to-drink sikwate, gift boxes, and convenient sikwate mix sachets. Our goal is to make Filipino cacao products accessible through convenient ordering and flexible pickup or delivery arrangements.

    What we plan to stand for

    • Filipino cacao tradition
    • Product quality
    • Affordable options
    • Convenient ordering
    • Thoughtful packaging
